description: Implementation of Customer Data Access Object (DAO) for database operations related to Customer entities, including retrieval by ID, name, nickname, and listing customers by store with filtering options.

classes.name: CustomerDAOImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Customer entity, providing methods for fetching customers by various criteria and listing customers for a store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer entity by its ID, including related entities via fetch joins.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Customers matching the given name, considering first and last names.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific store, with optional filtering based on CustomerCriteria.

methods.name: getByNick with storeId
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer by nickname within a specific store context.

methods.name: listByStore (overload)
methods.description: Lists all customers for a store without filtering.
